name: V-Primordial-Burst
prompt: Edit this Veigar ultimate spell icon. Make it visually DISTINCT from a blue swirling Z orb. Dominant palette is DARK PURPLE, plum and almost-black violet, virtually no blue or cyan. A menacing compact purple electrical sphere surrounds a substantially LARGER blazing pure WHITE core, occupying roughly one third of the sphere diameter. Three thick irregular white-to-lavender lightning strokes radiate from the core through dark purple masses; keep them angular, NOT spiraling. Strong white center against deep dark purple body, restrained violet outer glow. Preserve simple soft hand-painted Warcraft III icon style, broad shapes readable at 64x64, no tiny lightning branches, sparks, particles, gold, faces, extra objects, text or frame. Quiet smoky dark-purple backdrop. Keep composition focused on a single electrical burst.

name: C-Dark-Matter
prompt: Edit this Veigar Dark Matter meteor impact icon. Preserve its extremely DARK near-black indigo core and soft Warcraft III painted style, but reshape the huge round ball into a noticeably THINNER bulb-shaped COMET: a compact rounded teardrop head at the ground, about 35 percent of image width, tapering upward into a narrow long blue-violet tail. Slight diagonal descent from upper left to lower center. Head remains dark, not luminous. Show the moment it strikes: pronounced outward horizontal impact wave across the bottom third, bright cyan-white contact point fading through violet and a small amount of magenta at outer blast edges. Broad spreading explosion lobes and only two or three broad ground fissures. Clear dark negative space beside the narrow comet so impact reads at tiny icon size. Simple composition: one dark comet and one colorful outward ground explosion. No particle shower, fine debris, intricate cracks, background scenery, text or frame. Soft broad painted edges, not crisp detailed AI art.
